scope: Public literature only; no controlled data or other reviewer outputs inspected

sources.title: Molecular Causes for BUBR1 Dysfunction in the Human Cancer Predisposition Syndrome Mosaic Variegated Aneuploidy
sources.model: Published human MVA transformed lymphoblasts/fibroblasts; HeLa and U2OS replacement systems
sources.intervention: Wild-type/mutant BUBR1 complementation; matched-abundance expression; HSP90 and proteasome perturbation
sources.observation: Checkpoint response recovered with wild-type complementation and abundance restoration for selected unstable mutants; stable alleles could separate checkpoint and alignment functions.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Allele selection and transformed cells limit transfer; HSP90 inhibition destabilized mutants. No therapeutic drug rescue established.
sources.inspected_content: Results and Discussion; Figures 1-5 and associated legends

sources.title: BubR1 allelic effects drive phenotypic heterogeneity in mosaic-variegated aneuploidy progeria syndrome
sources.model: Engineered BubR1 allele combinations in mice and MEFs
sources.intervention: Genetic allele combinations; cellular checkpoint/error-correction assays
sources.observation: Similar protein reductions accompanied distinct phenotypes; some muscle phenotypes correlated with mTORC1 hyperactivity.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Species and allele effects; no mTOR-drug rescue demonstrated. Correction concerns Figure 2E lymphoma image/method; this review does not use that panel.

sources.title: Integration of Kinase and Phosphatase Activities by BUBR1 Ensures Formation of Stable Kinetochore-Microtubule Attachments
sources.intervention: KARD deletion/phosphosite manipulation; PLK1 or Aurora B inhibition
sources.observation: KARD phosphorylation promoted PP2A-B56 recruitment and attachments; inhibiting Aurora B reverted the attachment defect.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Engineered cellular attachment endpoint; not demonstration of safe long-term segregation rescue. Global phosphatase or kinase modulation is not equivalent to local balanced recruitment.
sources.inspected_content: Results and original figure legends, particularly Figures 1-5

sources.title: BUBR1 Pseudokinase Domain Promotes Kinetochore PP2A-B56 Recruitment, Spindle Checkpoint Silencing, and Chromosome Alignment
sources.model: Human HeLa-derived replacement systems and biochemical assays
sources.intervention: Pseudokinase-domain mutants/deletion; analysis of KARD phosphorylation and phosphatase recruitment
sources.observation: Perturbations impaired KARD phosphorylation, PP2A recruitment and checkpoint silencing; chromosome alignment errors increased.
sources.contrary_or_limit: A structural/regulatory domain contribution complicates claims of kinase-domain dispensability; engineered constructs and expression levels limit allele extrapolation.
sources.inspected_content: Primary article reproduced on ResearchGate: summary, Results, original figure legends; not citation-page commentary

sources.title: SIRT2 induces the checkpoint kinase BubR1 to increase lifespan
sources.model: Aging mice and BubR1 hypomorphic mice
sources.observation: Abstract reports increased BubR1 abundance with SIRT2 overexpression or NMN; SIRT2 overexpression increased median survival, more strongly in males.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Only abstract/synopsis inspected; NMN abundance result must not be called NMN survival or human mutant rescue. Exposure bridge unresolved.
sources.inspected_content: Publisher abstract and synopsis; full-text access blocked

sources.title: Increased expression of BubR1 protects against aneuploidy and cancer and extends healthy lifespan
sources.observation: Reported genomic protection and reduced tumorigenesis; original figure legend reports correction of hypomorphic growth/aging phenotypes.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Genetic overexpression is not pharmacological stabilization of mutant protein; complete methods were not accessible.
sources.inspected_content: Abstract and original Figure 1 and age-pathology figure legends; primary article text not inspected in full

sources.title: Clearance of p16Ink4a-positive senescent cells delays ageing-associated disorders
sources.intervention: AP20187 activation of a transgenic cell-elimination system
sources.observation: Removal of p16-positive cells delayed selected tissue deterioration; later clearance attenuated progression.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Requires engineered transgene; not proof for a conventional senolytic, chromosome correction or developmental reversal.
sources.inspected_content: Abstract and original Figures 1-4 legends, author-hosted content

sources.title: P53 independent pathogenic mechanisms contribute to BubR1 microcephaly
sources.model: Conditional cortical BubR1 deletion in mice
sources.observation: DNA damage and residual cell death persisted; later cortical and neuronal rescue was limited and varied by endpoint.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Near-complete developmental loss differs from partial deficiency; DNA-damage origin remains unresolved. Downstream suppression did not provide broad rescue.

sources.title: Biallelic TRIP13 mutations predispose to Wilms tumor and chromosome missegregation
sources.model: Published human TRIP13-deficient lymphoblasts; engineered HCT116 cells
sources.observation: Restoring TRIP13 rescued chromosome instability and checkpoint defects in deficient cells.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Alternative etiology evidence only; no alternative finding asserted for the current hypothesis and no BUB1B-drug rescue.
sources.inspected_content: Primary manuscript pages 3-5: live imaging, checkpoint assays and complementation

access_note: Abstract labels are conservative when original figure legends were also inspected. Failed/metadata-only URLs are not evidence. Search snippets alone were not used as verified experiments.
